$comment: Copy-paste packaging for generic MCP server directories (Smithery, Glama, mcp.so, a client's own directory) that list a server by its client config rather than by a package-registry install. No npm package exists for this project on purpose (see docs/npm-archive.md), so there is no `npx` form to offer — the install is: clone the repo, then point an MCP client at the committed bundle it ships. test/release/registry-install-path.test.ts spawns this exact command against the checked-out repo and asserts it starts outside a vault.
name: ost-agent
description: Append-only Opportunity Solution Tree MCP server for Claude Code and other MCP clients.

steps: Add the block below to your MCP client's server config, with OST_VAULT set to the directory you want the tree to live in.
